title: Fan va texnologiya munozarasi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ilmiy lug‘at va to‘g‘ri hamroh so‘zlar bilan jarayonni bosqichma-bosqich tushuntira olasiz, texnologiyaning ta’sirini ehtiyotkor iboralar bilan baholaysiz, axloqiy masalalarda tan olish va e’tiroz bildirish orqali bahslashasiz hamda ilmiy kashfiyot haqida uch daqiqa izchil gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Fan haqida gapiramiz
board: Discussing science & technology
(Fan va texnologiya munozarasi)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda hisobot va rasmiy xat yozishni o‘rgandik: natija, xulosa va tavsiya tili. Bugun yozuvdan nutqqa o‘tamiz va fan hamda texnologiya haqida gapiramiz. Ilmiy lug‘at, jarayonni tushuntirish, ta’sirni baholash va axloqiy savollar. Dars oxirida bir ilmiy kashfiyot haqida uch daqiqa izchil gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we wrote reports and formal emails. Today we switch to speaking, and discuss science and technology: how things work, what impact they have, and where we should draw the line.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar hisobot va rasmiy xat yozdik. Bugun nutqqa o‘tamiz va fan hamda texnologiyani muhokama qilamiz: narsalar qanday ishlaydi, qanday ta’sir qiladi va chegarani qayerda qo‘yish kerak.

scenes.title: Ilmiy jarayon lug‘ati
board: hypothesis → experiment → evidence → findings
peer review → publication
breakthrough (katta yutuq)

examples.t: The hypothesis was tested in a series of experiments.
examples.uz: Faraz bir qator tajribalarda sinovdan o‘tkazildi.

examples.t: The findings were published after peer review.
examples.uz: Natijalar ekspertizadan keyin e’lon qilindi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi mavzu: ilmiy lug‘at. Ilm odatda hypothesis, ya’ni faraz bilan boshlanadi. Keyin experiment, tajriba o‘tkaziladi va evidence, dalil yig‘iladi. Natijalar, findings, maqolaga aylanishidan oldin peer review dan o‘tadi: boshqa olimlar uni tekshiradi. Breakthrough esa sohani o‘zgartiradigan katta kashfiyot. Evidence sanalmaydigan ot: a lot of evidence, evidences emas.
scenes.say: The hypothesis was tested in a series of experiments. The findings were published after peer review. Evidence is uncountable: we say a piece of evidence.
scenes.say_uz: Faraz bir qator tajribalarda sinovdan o‘tkazildi. Natijalar ekspertizadan keyin e’lon qilindi. Evidence sanalmaydi: a piece of evidence deymiz.

scenes.title: So‘z oilasi va urg‘u
board: SCIence · scienTIFic · SCIentist
techNOLogy · technoLOGical
hyPOTHesis (pl. hypotheses) · pheNOMenon (pl. phenomena)

examples.t: These phenomena are not yet fully understood.
examples.uz: Bu hodisalar hali to‘liq o‘rganilmagan.

scenes.say_native: Urg‘u so‘z oilasi ichida ko‘chadi. Science da urg‘u boshida, scientific da esa tif bo‘g‘inida. Technology da nol bo‘g‘inida, technological da esa log bo‘g‘inida. Yunoncha ko‘pliklarni ham eslang: bitta hypothesis, ko‘p hypotheses; bitta phenomenon, ko‘p phenomena; bitta criterion, ko‘p criteria. These phenomenon yoki a criteria deyish ko‘p uchraydigan xato.
scenes.say: Science, scientific, scientist. Technology, technological. One hypothesis, two hypotheses. One phenomenon, many phenomena.
scenes.say_uz: Fan, ilmiy, olim. Texnologiya, texnologik. Bitta faraz, ikkita faraz. Bitta hodisa, ko‘p hodisalar.

scenes.title: Hamroh so‘zlar
board: carry out / conduct research, an experiment
make a discovery · a breakthrough in…
test a hypothesis · draw conclusions

examples.t: Scientists made a breakthrough in battery technology.
examples.uz: Olimlar batareya texnologiyasida katta yutuqqa erishdi.

examples.t: The team conducted research into sleep and memory.
examples.uz: Jamoa uyqu va xotira bo‘yicha tadqiqot o‘tkazdi.

scenes.say_native: C1 darajasida so‘zning o‘zi emas, uning hamrohlari muhim. Research va experiment bilan carry out yoki conduct ishlatiladi. Discovery bilan make: make a discovery. Breakthrough dan keyin in: a breakthrough in battery technology. Research dan keyin into yoki on: research into sleep.
scenes.say: Scientists made a breakthrough in battery technology. The team conducted research into sleep and memory, and drew some surprising conclusions.
scenes.say_uz: Olimlar batareya texnologiyasida katta yutuqqa erishdi. Jamoa uyqu va xotira bo‘yicha tadqiqot o‘tkazdi va kutilmagan xulosalar chiqardi.

scenes.title: Soxta do‘stlar
board: texnika → equipment / machinery / appliances
technique = usul, uslub
fan (maktab fani) → subject · science

examples.t: The lab has modern equipment.
examples.uz: Laboratoriyada zamonaviy texnika bor.

examples.t: She uses a new technique to grow cells.
examples.uz: U hujayra o‘stirish uchun yangi usuldan foydalanadi.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek va rus tilidan keladigan soxta do‘stlar. Texnika so‘zi inglizcha technique emas. Technique bu usul yoki mahorat. Bizning texnikamiz inglizchada equipment, machinery yoki uy uchun appliances. Yana bir nozik farq: maktabdagi fan bu subject. Science esa tabiiy fanlar, ilm. My favourite science is history demaysiz, my favourite subject is history deysiz.
scenes.say: The lab has modern equipment. She uses a new technique to grow cells. And at school, history is a subject, not a science.
scenes.say_uz: Laboratoriyada zamonaviy texnika bor. U hujayra o‘stirish uchun yangi usuldan foydalanadi. Maktabda tarix esa fan, ya’ni subject, science emas.

scenes.title: Lug‘atdagi tipik xatolar
board: ✗ make an experiment → ✓ carry out / do an experiment
✗ a research, researches → ✓ research, a study
✗ equipments, informations → ✓ equipment, information
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: make an experiment. Tabiiy ingliz tilida carry out, conduct yoki do an experiment. Ikkinchisi: research odatda sanalmaydi, shuning uchun a research va researches xato. Bitta ishni aytmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, a study deng: a recent study shows. Uchinchisi: equipment va information ham sanalmaydi, ko‘plik qo‘shimchasi olmaydi.
scenes.say: Not: make an experiment, but carry out an experiment. Not: a research, but research, or a study. Not: equipments, but equipment.
scenes.say_uz: Make an experiment emas, carry out an experiment. A research emas, research yoki a study. Equipments emas, equipment.

scenes.title: Fe’lni tanlang
board: 1) They ___ an experiment on 200 volunteers.
2) Researchers ___ a major breakthrough ___ cancer treatment.
3) It is too early to ___ any conclusions.
4) A recent ___ shows that screens affect sleep.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Bo‘sh joylarga mos so‘zni qo‘ying. Birinchi gapda tajriba bilan qaysi fe’l ishlatiladi? Ikkinchisida ham fe’l, ham predlog kerak. Uchinchisida xulosa bilan keladigan fe’lni eslang. To‘rtinchisida esa sanaladigan ot kerak, chunki oldida a artikli turibdi. Gaplarni to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: Complete the sentences. Think about the verb, the preposition, and whether the noun is countable.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni to‘ldiring. Fe’l, predlog va ot sanaladimi yoki yo‘qligi haqida o‘ylang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) carried out / conducted
2) made … in
3) draw
4) study
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: they carried out yoki conducted an experiment on two hundred volunteers. Ikkinchisi: researchers made a major breakthrough in cancer treatment. Uchinchisi: it is too early to draw any conclusions. To‘rtinchisi: a recent study shows, chunki research oldida a qo‘yib bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: They carried out an experiment on two hundred volunteers. Researchers made a major breakthrough in cancer treatment. It is too early to draw any conclusions. A recent study shows that screens affect sleep.
scenes.say_uz: Ular ikki yuz ko‘ngilli ustida tajriba o‘tkazdi. Tadqiqotchilar saraton davolashda katta yutuqqa erishdi. Xulosa chiqarishga hali erta. Yaqindagi tadqiqot ekranlar uyquga ta’sir qilishini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Jarayonni tushuntirish: bog‘lovchilar
board: The process begins with… · First of all, …
Once… , … · At this stage, … · This, in turn, …
Eventually / Finally, …

examples.t: Once the data is collected, it is analysed by software.
examples.uz: Ma’lumot yig‘ilgach, u dastur yordamida tahlil qilinadi.

examples.t: This, in turn, reduces the cost of production.
examples.uz: Bu esa o‘z navbatida ishlab chiqarish narxini kamaytiradi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu: jarayonni tushuntirish. Tinglovchi qayerda turganini bilishi kerak, shuning uchun bosqichlarni belgilang. The process begins with bilan boshlang. Keyin once, ya’ni biror narsa bo‘lgach: once the data is collected. This, in turn, o‘z navbatida degani va zanjirni ko‘rsatadi. Oxirida eventually yoki finally.
scenes.say: The process begins with data collection. Once the data is collected, it is analysed by software. This, in turn, reduces the cost of production.
scenes.say_uz: Jarayon ma’lumot yig‘ishdan boshlanadi. Ma’lumot yig‘ilgach, u dastur yordamida tahlil qilinadi. Bu esa o‘z navbatida ishlab chiqarish narxini kamaytiradi.

scenes.title: Jarayonda majhul nisbat
board: Water is heated → steam is produced
The steam is used to drive a turbine.
focus on the process, not the person

examples.t: The water is heated until it turns into steam.
examples.uz: Suv bug‘ga aylanguncha isitiladi.

examples.t: The steam is then used to drive a turbine.
examples.uz: Keyin bug‘ turbinani aylantirish uchun ishlatiladi.

scenes.say_native: Jarayonni tushuntirganda kim qilgani muhim emas, nima bo‘layotgani muhim. Shuning uchun majhul nisbat tabiiy: the water is heated, the steam is used. Then va first kabi so‘zlar majhul fe’l ichiga ham joylashadi: the steam is then used. Ammo hamma narsani majhul qilmang: o‘z-o‘zidan bo‘ladigan jarayonlar faol: water boils, the turbine spins.
scenes.say: The water is heated until it turns into steam. The steam is then used to drive a turbine, which spins and generates electricity.
scenes.say_uz: Suv bug‘ga aylanguncha isitiladi. Keyin bug‘ turbinani aylantirish uchun ishlatiladi, turbina aylanib elektr energiyasi hosil qiladi.

scenes.title: Namuna: vaksina qanday ishlaydi
board: mRNA vaccine → instructions to cells
cells make a harmless protein
immune system → antibodies + memory cells

examples.t: The immune system learns to recognise the virus.
examples.uz: Immun tizimi virusni tanishni o‘rganadi.

scenes.say_native: Mana jarayonni tushuntirishning namunasi: mRNA vaksina qanday ishlaydi. E’tibor bering: bosqichlar aniq, bog‘lovchilar bor, majhul nisbat o‘rinli ishlatilgan. Va murakkab mavzu oddiy so‘zlar bilan tushuntirilgan. C1 darajasi murakkab gapirish emas, murakkab narsani aniq gapirishdir.
scenes.say: An mRNA vaccine contains instructions for making a harmless piece of the virus’s protein. Once the vaccine is injected, our cells read these instructions and produce the protein. The immune system recognises it as foreign and produces antibodies. Memory cells are also created, so if the real virus appears, the body responds quickly. The mRNA itself is broken down within days.
scenes.say_uz: mRNA vaksina virus oqsilining zararsiz qismini yasash bo‘yicha ko‘rsatmani o‘z ichiga oladi. Vaksina yuborilgach, hujayralarimiz ko‘rsatmani o‘qib, oqsilni ishlab chiqaradi. Immun tizimi uni begona deb taniydi va antitelalar ishlab chiqaradi. Xotira hujayralari ham hosil bo‘ladi, shuning uchun haqiqiy virus paydo bo‘lsa, organizm tez javob beradi. mRNA ning o‘zi bir necha kunda parchalanadi.

scenes.title: Sabab va oqibat fe’llari
board: A leads to / results in / triggers / gives rise to B
B results from / stems from / is caused by A
result IN (oqibat) ≠ result FROM (sabab)

examples.t: Rising temperatures have led to more frequent droughts.
examples.uz: Haroratning oshishi qurg‘oqchiliklar ko‘payishiga olib keldi.

examples.t: Many of these problems stem from poor design.
examples.uz: Bu muammolarning ko‘pi yomon loyihadan kelib chiqadi.

scenes.say_native: Sabab va oqibatni bog‘laydigan fe’llar ikki yo‘nalishda ishlaydi. Sababdan oqibatga: lead to, result in, trigger, give rise to. Oqibatdan sababga: result from, stem from, be caused by. Eng ko‘p chalkashadigan juftlik result in va result from. Smoking results in disease: chekish kasallikka olib keladi. Disease results from smoking: kasallik chekishdan kelib chiqadi.
scenes.say: Rising temperatures have led to more frequent droughts. Many of these problems stem from poor design. Smoking results in disease; disease results from smoking.
scenes.say_uz: Haroratning oshishi qurg‘oqchiliklar ko‘payishiga olib keldi. Bu muammolarning ko‘pi yomon loyihadan kelib chiqadi. Chekish kasallikka olib keladi; kasallik chekishdan kelib chiqadi.

scenes.title: Sabab-oqibatdagi xatolar
board: ✗ It results to… → ✓ It results in…
✗ The device is consisted of… → ✓ consists of / is made up of
✗ It leads to increase prices → ✓ leads to higher prices / to an increase in prices
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Result to deyilmaydi, faqat result in yoki result from. Consist of faol fe’l, majhul bo‘lmaydi: the device consists of three parts yoki is made up of. Va lead to dagi to predlog, shuning uchun undan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi: leads to higher prices yoki leads to an increase in prices. Leads to increase prices xato.
scenes.say: Not: results to, but results in. Not: is consisted of, but consists of. Not: leads to increase prices, but leads to higher prices.
scenes.say_uz: Results to emas, results in. Is consisted of emas, consists of. Leads to increase prices emas, leads to higher prices.

scenes.title: Jarayonni tushuntiring
board: How a solar panel works:
sunlight · solar cells · electrons
direct current (DC) · inverter · alternating current (AC)
home use / the grid
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz tushuntiring. Ekrandagi kalit so‘zlar yordamida quyosh paneli qanday ishlashini to‘rt-besh gapda ayting. Kamida ikkita bog‘lovchi, masalan once va this, in turn, va kamida bitta majhul fe’l ishlating. Oxirida elektr qayerga borishini ham ayting.
scenes.say: Explain how a solar panel works, using the key words on the board. Use sequencing language and at least one passive verb.
scenes.say_uz: Ekrandagi kalit so‘zlardan foydalanib, quyosh paneli qanday ishlashini tushuntiring. Ketma-ketlik iboralari va kamida bitta majhul fe’l ishlating.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: Sunlight hits the solar cells, knocking electrons loose.
These electrons flow as direct current.
The DC is then converted into AC by an inverter.
It is used at home or fed into the grid.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javob. The process begins when sunlight hits the solar cells, knocking electrons loose. These electrons flow, creating a direct current. Once produced, the current is converted into alternating current by an inverter. Finally, the electricity is used at home or fed into the grid.
scenes.say: The process begins when sunlight hits the solar cells, knocking electrons loose. These electrons flow, creating a direct current. This is then converted into alternating current by an inverter, and finally used at home or fed into the grid.
scenes.say_uz: Jarayon quyosh nuri panel hujayralariga tushib, elektronlarni ajratib chiqarishidan boshlanadi. Bu elektronlar oqib, o‘zgarmas tok hosil qiladi. Keyin u invertor yordamida o‘zgaruvchan tokka aylantiriladi va nihoyat uyda ishlatiladi yoki tarmoqqa uzatiladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ilmiy podkast
board: Podcast: gene editing
CRISPR · guide RNA · Cas9
(gen tahriri)
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Ilmiy podkast boshlovchisi genetik olim bilan CRISPR texnologiyasi haqida gaplashmoqda. Tinglang: olim bu texnologiyani qanday tasvirlaydi, u qanday ishlaydi va qaysi kasallikni davolashda allaqachon qo‘llanmoqda. Olim jarayonni tushuntirishda qaysi bog‘lovchilarni ishlatishini ham kuzating.
scenes.say: Host: So what exactly is CRISPR? Scientist: Think of it as a pair of molecular scissors. A guide molecule leads an enzyme called Cas9 to a precise spot in the DNA, and the enzyme cuts it. The cell then repairs the cut, and this allows us to disable or correct a gene. Host: Is it already in use? Scientist: Yes, a CRISPR-based therapy has been approved to treat sickle cell disease in several countries.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlovchi: Xo‘sh, CRISPR aslida nima? Olim: Uni molekulyar qaychi deb tasavvur qiling. Yo‘naltiruvchi molekula Cas9 degan fermentni DNK dagi aniq nuqtaga olib boradi va ferment uni kesadi. Keyin hujayra kesikni tiklaydi, bu bizga genni o‘chirish yoki tuzatish imkonini beradi. Boshlovchi: U allaqachon qo‘llanyaptimi? Olim: Ha, CRISPR ga asoslangan davo bir necha mamlakatda o‘roqsimon hujayrali anemiyani davolash uchun ruxsat olgan.

scenes.title: Podkast bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What image does the scientist use?
2) What does Cas9 do?
3) What happens after the cut?
4) Which disease is mentioned?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Olim CRISPR ni qanday obraz bilan tasvirladi? Cas9 fermenti nima qiladi? Kesikdan keyin nima bo‘ladi va bu olimlarga qanday imkon beradi? Qaysi kasallikni davolash uchun ruxsat berilgan? Javoblarni inglizcha to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Olim ishlatgan bog‘lovchilarni ham eslang.
scenes.say: What image does the scientist use? What does Cas9 do? What happens after the cut? Which disease is mentioned?
scenes.say_uz: Olim qanday obraz ishlatadi? Cas9 nima qiladi? Kesikdan keyin nima bo‘ladi? Qaysi kasallik tilga olinadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Molecular scissors.
2) It cuts the DNA at a precise spot.
3) The cell repairs it; a gene can be disabled or corrected.
4) Sickle cell disease.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Olim CRISPR ni molekulyar qaychiga o‘xshatdi. Cas9 fermenti DNK ni aniq bir nuqtada kesadi, uni yo‘naltiruvchi molekula olib boradi. Keyin hujayra kesikni tiklaydi va bu genni o‘chirish yoki tuzatish imkonini beradi. Kasallik: sickle cell disease, ya’ni o‘roqsimon hujayrali anemiya.
scenes.say: He compares it to molecular scissors. Cas9 cuts the DNA at a precise spot. The cell repairs the cut, so a gene can be disabled or corrected. The disease is sickle cell disease.
scenes.say_uz: U uni molekulyar qaychiga o‘xshatadi. Cas9 DNK ni aniq nuqtada kesadi. Hujayra kesikni tiklaydi, shuning uchun genni o‘chirish yoki tuzatish mumkin. Kasallik o‘roqsimon hujayrali anemiya.

scenes.title: Ta’sirni baholash
board: X has had a profound / far-reaching impact on…
The benefits far outweigh the drawbacks.
It’s a double-edged sword.

examples.t: The internet has had a profound impact on how we learn.
examples.uz: Internet o‘rganish usulimizga chuqur ta’sir ko‘rsatdi.

examples.t: Social media is a double-edged sword.
examples.uz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ikki tomonlama qilich.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: ta’sirni baholash. Good yoki bad o‘rniga aniq iboralar ishlating. Have a profound, far-reaching yoki significant impact on: chuqur ta’sir ko‘rsatmoq. The benefits outweigh the drawbacks: foydasi zararidan ustun. A double-edged sword: ham foyda, ham zarar keltiradigan narsa. E’tibor bering: impact on, predlog on.
scenes.say: The internet has had a profound impact on how we learn. In my view, the benefits far outweigh the drawbacks. Social media, however, is a double-edged sword.
scenes.say_uz: Internet o‘rganish usulimizga chuqur ta’sir ko‘rsatdi. Menimcha, foydasi zararidan ancha ustun. Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar esa ikki tomonlama qilich.

scenes.title: Ehtiyotkor baho
board: Arguably, … · To some extent, …
There is a real risk that…
It remains to be seen whether…

examples.t: Arguably, smartphones have changed childhood more than any other invention.
examples.uz: Aytish mumkinki, smartfonlar bolalikni har qanday ixtirodan ko‘proq o‘zgartirdi.

examples.t: It remains to be seen whether the technology is safe in the long term.
examples.uz: Texnologiya uzoq muddatda xavfsizmi, buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Fan haqida gapirganda kategorik bo‘lmang, chunki dalil ko‘pincha to‘liq emas. Arguably: aytish mumkinki, ya’ni bu bahsli, lekin men shunday hisoblayman. To some extent: ma’lum darajada. There is a real risk that: jiddiy xavf bor. It remains to be seen whether: buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Arguably, smartphones have changed childhood more than any other invention. It remains to be seen whether the technology is safe in the long term.
scenes.say_uz: Aytish mumkinki, smartfonlar bolalikni har qanday ixtirodan ko‘proq o‘zgartirdi. Texnologiya uzoq muddatda xavfsizmi, buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Qisqa va uzoq muddatli oqibatlar
board: in the short term ↔ in the long run
unintended consequences · side effects
a knock-on effect (zanjir ta’sir)

examples.t: Automation may cut costs in the short term, but in the long run it could reshape the job market.
examples.uz: Avtomatlashtirish qisqa muddatda xarajatni kamaytirishi mumkin, lekin uzoq muddatda mehnat bozorini o‘zgartirishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Chuqur baho vaqt o‘lchovini hisobga oladi: in the short term va in the long run. Yana bir C1 tushuncha: unintended consequences, ya’ni kutilmagan oqibatlar. Knock-on effect esa zanjir ta’sir: bir o‘zgarish boshqasini keltirib chiqaradi. Side effects asosan dori va davolashda ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Automation may cut costs in the short term, but in the long run it could reshape the job market, with knock-on effects for education and training.
scenes.say_uz: Avtomatlashtirish qisqa muddatda xarajatni kamaytirishi mumkin, lekin uzoq muddatda mehnat bozorini o‘zgartirib, ta’lim va malaka oshirishga zanjir ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha munozara odati bilan qiyos
board: albatta, shubhasiz → overuse sounds too strong
I think, I think, I think → vary it
In my view · As I see it · I’d argue that

examples.t: As I see it, the real problem is access, not cost.
examples.uz: Menimcha, asl muammo narxda emas, foydalanish imkoniyatida.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbekcha bahsda albatta, shubhasiz kabi kuchli so‘zlar ko‘p ishlatiladi va bu tabiiy eshitiladi. Ingliz tilida esa of course va definitely ni tez-tez ishlatsangiz, tinglovchi buni o‘ziga ishonch emas, haddan tashqari keskinlik deb qabul qilishi mumkin. Ikkinchi odat: har gapni I think bilan boshlash. Uni almashtiring: in my view, as I see it, I’d argue that.
scenes.say: As I see it, the real problem is access, not cost. I’d argue that schools should teach digital skills much earlier.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, asl muammo narxda emas, foydalanish imkoniyatida. Maktablar raqamli ko‘nikmalarni ancha erta o‘rgatishi kerak, deb hisoblayman.

scenes.title: Ta’sir haqida xatolar
board: ✗ It has big influence to society → ✓ a significant influence on society
✗ It affects on our health → ✓ It affects our health / has an effect on
✗ make an impact to → ✓ make an impact on
scenes.say_native: Ta’sir haqida eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolar. Influence va impact dan keyin on keladi, to emas: a significant influence on society. Affect fe’l va predlogsiz: it affects our health. Effect esa ot: it has an effect on our health. Affects on deyish rus tilidagi влияет на ta’siridan keladi. Big influence o‘rniga significant yoki considerable influence tanlang.
scenes.say: Not: big influence to society, but a significant influence on society. Not: affects on our health, but affects our health, or has an effect on our health.
scenes.say_uz: Big influence to society emas, a significant influence on society. Affects on our health emas, affects our health yoki has an effect on our health.

scenes.title: Ta’sirni baholang
board: Topic: AI tools in schools
Use: a profound impact on · outweigh · double-edged sword
+ one hedge: arguably / to some extent / it remains to be seen
scenes.say_native: Endi gapiring. Maktabda sun’iy intellekt vositalaridan foydalanish ta’sirini uch-to‘rt gapda baholang. Ekrandagi iboralardan kamida ikkitasini va bitta ehtiyotkor iborani ishlating. Ham foydasini, ham xavfini ayting. Qisqa va uzoq muddatni ajratsangiz, javobingiz yanada kuchli bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Evaluate the impact of AI tools in schools. Mention a benefit, a risk, and use at least one hedge.
scenes.say_uz: Maktablarda sun’iy intellekt vositalarining ta’sirini baholang. Bitta foyda, bitta xavfni ayting va kamida bitta ehtiyotkor ibora ishlating.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: AI tools could have a profound impact on learning.
They give instant feedback, but there is a real risk that…
students stop thinking for themselves.
It remains to be seen whether the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javob. AI tools could have a profound impact on learning. In the short term, they give students instant feedback. However, there is a real risk that students stop thinking for themselves. It remains to be seen whether the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.
scenes.say: AI tools could have a profound impact on learning. In the short term, they give students instant feedback. However, there is a real risk that students stop thinking for themselves.
scenes.say_uz: Sun’iy intellekt vositalari ta’limga chuqur ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin. Qisqa muddatda ular o‘quvchilarga tezkor fikr-mulohaza beradi. Biroq o‘quvchilar mustaqil fikrlashni to‘xtatishi xavfi jiddiy.

scenes.title: Axloqiy masalalar lug‘ati
board: ethical concerns · privacy · consent
accountability · bias · misuse
playing God · a slippery slope

examples.t: The app collected data without users’ consent.
examples.uz: Ilova foydalanuvchilar roziligisiz ma’lumot yig‘gan.

examples.t: Who is accountable when a self-driving car crashes?
examples.uz: O‘zi yuradigan mashina avariyaga uchrasa, kim javobgar?

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: axloqiy jihatlar. Asosiy so‘zlar: privacy, shaxsiy hayot daxlsizligi; consent, rozilik; accountability, javobgarlik; bias, xolis emaslik; misuse, suiiste’mol. Playing God: tabiatga haddan tashqari aralashish. A slippery slope: bir kichik qadam xavfli zanjirga olib kelishi. Ethics, ya’ni axloq fani, ethical sifat. It’s not ethic emas, it’s not ethical.
scenes.say: The app collected data without users’ consent. Who is accountable when a self-driving car crashes? Some critics say gene editing is a slippery slope.
scenes.say_uz: Ilova foydalanuvchilar roziligisiz ma’lumot yig‘gan. O‘zi yuradigan mashina avariyaga uchrasa, kim javobgar? Ba’zi tanqidchilar gen tahririni xavfli yo‘lning boshi deydi.

scenes.title: Axloqiy savol qo‘yish
board: It raises serious questions about…
Where do we draw the line?
The question is not whether…, but how…

examples.t: Facial recognition raises serious questions about privacy.
examples.uz: Yuzni tanish texnologiyasi shaxsiy hayot haqida jiddiy savollar tug‘diradi.

examples.t: The question is not whether we use AI, but how we regulate it.
examples.uz: Savol sun’iy intellektni ishlatamizmi-yo‘qmi emas, uni qanday tartibga solamiz.

scenes.say_native: Axloqiy masalani ochish uchun tayyor ramkalar. It raises serious questions about: jiddiy savollar tug‘diradi. Where do we draw the line: chegarani qayerda qo‘yamiz. Eng kuchlisi: the question is not whether, but how. Bu ibora bahsni ha yoki yo‘q darajasidan chiqarib, qanday degan amaliy darajaga ko‘taradi.
scenes.say: Facial recognition raises serious questions about privacy. The question is not whether we use AI, but how we regulate it. So where do we draw the line?
scenes.say_uz: Yuzni tanish texnologiyasi shaxsiy hayot haqida jiddiy savollar tug‘diradi. Savol sun’iy intellektni ishlatishda emas, uni qanday tartibga solishda. Xo‘sh, chegarani qayerda qo‘yamiz?

scenes.title: Tan olish va e’tiroz
board: Granted, … but…
While I accept that…, I’d argue that…
That’s a fair point, but have you considered…?

examples.t: Granted, the technology saves lives, but it also raises privacy concerns.
examples.uz: To‘g‘ri, texnologiya hayot saqlaydi, lekin u shaxsiy hayot borasida xavotir ham uyg‘otadi.

examples.t: While I accept that regulation is needed, I’d argue that a ban goes too far.
examples.uz: Tartibga solish kerakligini tan olaman, lekin taqiqlash haddan oshish deb hisoblayman.

scenes.say_native: C1 munozarasining kaliti: avval qarshi fikrni tan olish, keyin o‘z fikrni aytish. Bu concession and counter-argument deyiladi. Granted, ... but: to‘g‘ri, ammo. While I accept that, I’d argue that: tan olaman, lekin. That’s a fair point, but have you considered: yaxshi fikr, ammo buni o‘ylab ko‘rdingizmi.
scenes.say: Granted, the technology saves lives, but it also raises privacy concerns. While I accept that regulation is needed, I’d argue that a complete ban goes too far.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri, texnologiya hayot saqlaydi, lekin shaxsiy hayot borasida xavotir ham uyg‘otadi. Tartibga solish kerakligini tan olaman, ammo to‘liq taqiq haddan oshish deb hisoblayman.

scenes.title: Fikr bildirishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ According to me, … → ✓ In my view, …
✗ In my opinion, I think… → ✓ In my opinion, …
✗ It is not ethic. → ✓ It is not ethical. / It is unethical.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. According to me tabiiy emas, chunki according to boshqa manbaga ishora qiladi: according to the study. O‘zingiz uchun in my view yoki as I see it. Ikkinchisi takror: in my opinion, I think, ikkalasi bir ma’no, bittasini qoldiring. Uchinchisi: ethic sifat emas. It is not ethical yoki it is unethical. Ethics esa ot.
scenes.say: Not: according to me, but in my view. Not: in my opinion, I think, just one of them. And not: it is not ethic, but it is unethical.
scenes.say_uz: According to me emas, in my view. In my opinion, I think emas, faqat bittasi. It is not ethic emas, it is unethical.

scenes.title: Tan oling va e’tiroz bildiring
board: 1) Gene editing will cure every disease.
2) Self-driving cars are safer than human drivers.
3) Children should not use smartphones at all.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta fikrga javob bering. Har birida avval qisman tan oling, keyin e’tiroz bildiring. Granted, while I accept that va that’s a fair point iboralarini navbat bilan ishlating. Imkon bo‘lsa, axloqiy so‘zlardan birini qo‘shing: consent, accountability yoki misuse.
scenes.say: Respond to each statement. First concede part of the point, then give your counter-argument.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir fikrga javob bering. Avval qisman tan oling, keyin o‘z e’tirozingizni ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1) Granted, it has huge potential, but ‘every disease’ is an overstatement.
2) While I accept that they may reduce accidents, the question of accountability remains.
3) That’s a fair point about screen time, but a total ban seems unrealistic.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchi: granted, gene editing has huge potential, but saying it will cure every disease is an overstatement. Ikkinchi: while I accept that self-driving cars may reduce accidents, the question of accountability remains. Uchinchi: that’s a fair point about screen time, but a total ban seems unrealistic.
scenes.say: Granted, gene editing has huge potential, but saying it will cure every disease is an overstatement. While I accept that self-driving cars may reduce accidents, the question of accountability remains.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri, gen tahririning salohiyati ulkan, ammo u har qanday kasallikni davolaydi deyish mubolag‘a. O‘zi yuradigan mashinalar avariyalarni kamaytirishi mumkinligini tan olaman, lekin javobgarlik masalasi ochiq qolmoqda.

scenes.title: Tinglash: yuzni tanish bo‘yicha bahs
board: Debate: facial recognition in public spaces
Speaker A: for · Speaker B: against
(jamoat joylarida yuzni tanish)
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: ikki kishi jamoat joylarida yuzni tanish texnologiyasi haqida bahslashmoqda. Tinglang: birinchi spiker qanday foydani aytadi, ikkinchisi qaysi ikki xavfni ko‘rsatadi va oxirida ular nimada kelishadi. Tan olish va e’tiroz iboralarini ham toping.
scenes.say: A: Facial recognition helps the police find missing people and suspects in minutes. B: Granted, that’s a real benefit. But it raises serious questions about privacy. Nobody consented to being scanned. And studies have found that some systems are less accurate for certain groups, so bias is a real risk. A: That’s a fair point. Perhaps the question is not whether we use it, but under what rules. B: On that, I agree.
scenes.say_uz: A: Yuzni tanish politsiyaga yo‘qolgan odamlar va gumondorlarni daqiqalarda topishga yordam beradi. B: To‘g‘ri, bu haqiqiy foyda. Lekin u shaxsiy hayot haqida jiddiy savollar tug‘diradi. Hech kim skanerlanishga rozilik bermagan. Tadqiqotlar ba’zi tizimlar ayrim guruhlar uchun kamroq aniq ekanini ko‘rsatgan, demak xolis emaslik xavfi bor. A: Yaxshi fikr. Balki savol uni ishlatishda emas, qanday qoidalar asosida ishlatishdadir. B: Bunga qo‘shilaman.

scenes.title: Bahs bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What benefit does A mention?
2) What two risks does B raise?
3) What do they finally agree on?
4) Find one concession phrase.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. A qanday foydani aytdi? B qaysi ikki xavfni ko‘rsatdi? Oxirida ular nimada kelishishdi? Va dialogdan bitta tan olish iborasini toping. Javoblarni inglizcha to‘liq gap bilan ayting va bugungi axloqiy atamalarni ishlating. Kim kimga qo‘shilganiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: What benefit does A mention? What two risks does B raise? What do they finally agree on? Find one concession phrase.
scenes.say_uz: A qanday foydani aytadi? B qaysi ikki xavfni ko‘taradi? Oxirida nimada kelishishadi? Bitta tan olish iborasini toping.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Finding missing people and suspects quickly.
2) Lack of consent (privacy) and bias.
3) The real issue is the rules for its use.
4) Granted, … / That’s a fair point.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. A texnologiya yo‘qolgan odamlar va gumondorlarni tez topishga yordam berishini aytdi. B ikki xavfni ko‘rsatdi: rozilik yo‘qligi, ya’ni shaxsiy hayot masalasi, va ba’zi guruhlar uchun aniqlik pastligi, ya’ni bias. Oxirida ular asosiy savol qoidalar ekanida kelishdi. Tan olish iboralari: granted va that’s a fair point.
scenes.say: A says it helps find missing people and suspects quickly. B raises consent and bias. They agree that the real issue is the rules for using it.
scenes.say_uz: A u yo‘qolganlar va gumondorlarni tez topishga yordam berishini aytadi. B rozilik va xolislik masalasini ko‘taradi. Ular asosiy masala undan foydalanish qoidalari ekanida kelishadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kontrast urg‘u va bog‘lanish
board: The question is not WHETHER, but HOW.
a lot of /ə ˈlɒt əv/ → /əˈlɒtəv/
in terms of /ɪn ˈtɜːmz əv/ · as a result of

examples.t: It’s not the technology that’s dangerous, it’s how we use it.
examples.uz: Xavfli texnologiyaning o‘zi emas, uni qanday ishlatishimiz.

scenes.say_native: Bahsda kontrast urg‘u juda kuchli vosita. The question is not whether, but how: urg‘u whether va how ga tushadi, qolgan so‘zlar kuchsiz. Ikkinchi nuqta: kuchsiz shakl va bog‘lanish. A lot of tez nutqda bitta so‘zdek eshitiladi, of esa /əv/ bo‘ladi. In terms of va as a result of da ham of kuchsiz.
scenes.say: The question is not whether, but how. It’s not the technology that’s dangerous, it’s how we use it. As a result of this, a lot of people are worried.
scenes.say_uz: Savol ha yoki yo‘q emas, qanday. Xavfli texnologiyaning o‘zi emas, uni qanday ishlatishimiz. Shu sababli ko‘p odamlar xavotirda.

scenes.title: Uch daqiqalik nutq tuzilishi
board: 1 What it is (20 s) · 2 How it works (40 s)
3 Impact: benefits & risks (60 s)
4 Ethical questions (40 s) · 5 Your view (20 s)

examples.t: I’d like to talk about one of the most important breakthroughs of recent decades.
examples.uz: So‘nggi o‘n yilliklarning eng muhim kashfiyotlaridan biri haqida gapirmoqchiman.

scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi uchun tuzilma. Uch daqiqa besh qismga bo‘linadi. Kashfiyot nima, yigirma soniya. Qanday ishlaydi, qirq soniya: jarayon tili. Ta’siri, bir daqiqa: foyda va xavf. Axloqiy savollar, qirq soniya. Va o‘z fikringiz bilan yakun. Har qism orasida signpost ishlating: moving on to, as for the ethical side, to sum up.
scenes.say: I’d like to talk about one of the most important breakthroughs of recent decades. Moving on to how it works… As for the ethical side… To sum up…
scenes.say_uz: So‘nggi o‘n yilliklarning eng muhim kashfiyotlaridan biri haqida gapirmoqchiman. Endi qanday ishlashiga o‘tsak… Axloqiy tomoniga kelsak… Xulosa qilib aytganda…

scenes.title: Vaqt yutish iboralari
board: That’s an interesting question.
Let me put it this way…
How can I put it? · The way I see it…

examples.t: That’s a tricky one. Let me put it this way: the risks are manageable.
examples.uz: Bu qiyin savol. Shunday aytay: xavflarni boshqarish mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Gapirish imtihonida yoki jonli munozarada ba’zan o‘ylash uchun bir-ikki soniya kerak bo‘ladi. Uh yoki uzoq jimlik o‘rniga tayyor iboralar ishlating: that’s an interesting question, that’s a tricky one, let me put it this way, how can I put it. Ular tabiiy eshitiladi va fikrni yig‘ishga vaqt beradi.
scenes.say: That’s a tricky one. Let me put it this way: the risks are real, but they are manageable if we act early.
scenes.say_uz: Bu qiyin savol. Shunday aytay: xavflar haqiqiy, lekin erta harakat qilsak, ularni boshqarish mumkin.

scenes.title: Bir daqiqalik nutq
board: Choose: the internet · mRNA vaccines · renewable energy · smartphones
What it is → how it works → impact → one ethical question
Use signposts + one concession
scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy og‘zaki topshiriq. Ekrandagi kashfiyotlardan birini tanlang va bir daqiqa gapiring. To‘rt qismni qisqa qamrab oling: nima, qanday ishlaydi, ta’siri va bitta axloqiy savol. Signpost iboralar va kamida bitta tan olish iborasini ishlating. Vaqtni o‘lchang va baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Choose one breakthrough from the board and speak for one minute. Cover what it is, how it works, its impact and one ethical question.
scenes.say_uz: Ekrandagi kashfiyotlardan birini tanlang va bir daqiqa gapiring. U nima, qanday ishlaydi, ta’siri va bitta axloqiy savolni qamrab oling.

scenes.title: Namuna nutq
board: I’d like to talk about renewable energy…
Moving on to how it works…
As for its impact… Granted, … but…
To sum up, …
scenes.say_native: Namuna nutqni tinglang. E’tibor bering: kirish, jarayon, ta’sir, axloqiy savol va xulosa aniq ajratilgan, signpost iboralar bor, jarayonda majhul nisbat, baho qismida esa tan olish va e’tiroz ishlatilgan. Bir daqiqada hammasini aytish shart emas, lekin tuzilma ko‘rinib turishi kerak.
scenes.say: I’d like to talk about solar power. Moving on to how it works: sunlight is converted into electricity by solar cells. As for its impact, it has cut emissions and energy bills. Granted, panels require mining for materials, but the benefits far outweigh the drawbacks. To sum up, the question is not whether we switch to clean energy, but how fast.
scenes.say_uz: Quyosh energiyasi haqida gapirmoqchiman. Qanday ishlashiga kelsak: quyosh nuri hujayralar yordamida elektrga aylantiriladi. Ta’siriga kelsak, u chiqindilar va energiya to‘lovlarini kamaytirdi. To‘g‘ri, panellar uchun xomashyo qazib olish kerak, ammo foydasi zararidan ancha ustun. Xulosa qilib aytganda, savol toza energiyaga o‘tamizmi emas, qanchalik tez o‘tamiz.

scenes.title: Tezkor savollar
board: 1) Will robots replace teachers?
2) Should genetic testing of babies be compulsory?
3) Is space exploration worth the cost?
scenes.say_native: Tezkor savollar. Har biriga ikki-uch gapda javob bering. Vaqt yutish iborasi bilan boshlashingiz mumkin, keyin ehtiyotkor baho bering va kamida bitta savolda axloqiy jihatni eslating. Kategorik ha yoki yo‘q bilan cheklanmang, fikringizni asoslang. Har qism o‘z vazifasini bajarsin.
scenes.say: Will robots replace teachers? Should genetic testing of babies be compulsory? Is space exploration worth the cost?
scenes.say_uz: Robotlar o‘qituvchilarning o‘rnini egallaydimi? Chaqaloqlarni genetik tekshirish majburiy bo‘lishi kerakmi? Koinotni tadqiq qilish xarajatiga arziydimi?

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1) To some extent, but teaching is about relationships.
2) That raises serious questions about consent and privacy.
3) Arguably yes: it has given us GPS and weather satellites.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchi: to some extent robots may support teachers, but teaching is about relationships. Ikkinchi: that’s a tricky one; compulsory testing raises serious questions about consent and privacy. Uchinchi: arguably yes, since space research has given us technologies like satellite navigation and weather forecasting.
scenes.say: To some extent, robots may support teachers, but teaching is about relationships. Compulsory testing raises serious questions about consent. Arguably, space research has given us satellite navigation and better weather forecasts.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’lum darajada robotlar o‘qituvchilarga yordam berishi mumkin, lekin o‘qitish munosabatlarga asoslanadi. Majburiy tekshiruv rozilik borasida jiddiy savollar tug‘diradi. Aytish mumkinki, koinot tadqiqotlari bizga sun’iy yo‘ldosh navigatsiyasi va aniqroq ob-havo prognozini berdi.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: Vocabulary: conduct research · make a breakthrough in · evidence (U)
Processes: Once… · This, in turn… · passive
Impact: a profound impact on · outweigh · arguably
Ethics: raises questions about · Granted, … but…
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Ilmiy lug‘atda hamroh so‘zlar muhim: conduct research, make a breakthrough in, evidence sanalmaydi. Jarayonni bog‘lovchilar va majhul nisbat bilan bosqichma-bosqich tushuntiramiz. Ta’sirni impact on, outweigh va ehtiyotkor iboralar bilan baholaymiz. Axloqiy bahsda avval tan olamiz, keyin e’tiroz bildiramiz. Va kontrast urg‘u fikrni kuchaytiradi.
scenes.say: Use precise collocations, explain processes step by step, evaluate impact with care, and when you discuss ethics, concede before you counter.
scenes.say_uz: Aniq hamroh so‘zlarni ishlating, jarayonni bosqichma-bosqich tushuntiring, ta’sirni ehtiyotkorlik bilan baholang va axloqni muhokama qilganda avval tan olib, keyin e’tiroz bildiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: talk about a scientific breakthrough for 3 minutes
Check: 5 parts · process language · 2 hedges · 1 concession
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: bir ilmiy kashfiyot haqida uch daqiqa gapiring va o‘zingizni telefonga yozib oling. Mezon: besh qismli tuzilma, jarayon bog‘lovchilari va majhul nisbat, kamida ikkita ehtiyotkor ibora, bitta tan olish va e’tiroz, uzoq jimliklarsiz. Yozuvni qayta tinglab, xatolaringizni belgilang. Keyingi darsda iqtisod va biznes lug‘atini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, record yourself talking about a scientific breakthrough for three minutes. Next time, we study the vocabulary of economics and business.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: bir ilmiy kashfiyot haqida uch daqiqa gapirib, o‘zingizni yozib oling. Keyingi darsda iqtisod va biznes lug‘atini o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: Bir ilmiy kashfiyot (masalan, mRNA vaksinalar, quyosh energiyasi, internet yoki gen tahriri) haqida uch daqiqa gapiring va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Mezon: besh qismli tuzilma (nima, qanday ishlaydi, ta’siri, axloqiy savol, o‘z fikringiz), jarayon bog‘lovchilari va majhul nisbat, kamida ikkita ehtiyotkor ibora, bitta tan olish va e’tiroz, uzoq jimliklarsiz ravon nutq.

quiz.q: Choose the correct collocation: Scientists ___ an experiment on 50 mice.
quiz.why_uz: Experiment bilan carry out yoki conduct ishlatiladi. Make an experiment o‘zbek va rus tilidan ko‘chirilgan xato.

options: She did a research on bees.
She carried out research into bees.
She made a research about bees.
quiz.why_uz: Research odatda sanalmaydi va carry out bilan keladi; predlog into yoki on.
Yunoncha so‘z: bitta phenomenon, ko‘p phenomena.

quiz.q: In 'texnika' meaning machines, which English word is correct?
quiz.why_uz: Technique usul degani. Texnika ma’nosida equipment, machinery yoki appliances ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Rising sea levels could ___ the loss of coastal towns.
quiz.why_uz: Sababdan oqibatga result in. Result from teskari yo‘nalish, result to esa mavjud emas.
Scientific so‘zida urg‘u tif bo‘g‘iniga tushadi: /ˌsaɪənˈtɪfɪk/.

quiz.q: Smartphones have had a significant impact ___ family life.
quiz.why_uz: Impact va influence dan keyin on keladi.

options: Pollution has an affect on our health.
quiz.why_uz: Affect fe’l va predlogsiz ishlatiladi. Effect esa ot: has an effect on.

quiz.q: Which phrase concedes a point before disagreeing?
quiz.why_uz: Granted … but avval tan olib, keyin e’tiroz bildiradi. According to me va in my opinion, I think xato yoki ortiqcha.

quiz.q: Which sentence uses the passive correctly to describe a process?
options: The water heats and then is used the steam.
The water is heated, and the steam is then used to drive a turbine.
The water is heat and the steam use a turbine.
Someone heats the water and someone uses the steam.
quiz.why_uz: Jarayonda majhul nisbat: is heated, is then used. Then majhul fe’l ichida turishi mumkin.
